newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Police suspect fodder sold to bakeries.
newsitem.headline: Police suspect fodder sold to bakeries.

text.p: Taiwanese may have been eating cakes and breads made illegally from animal feed for as long as two years, an investigator said on Monday.
The national Investigation Bureau, acting on a tip-off, found more than 1,000 tonnes of milk-based animal feed powder at a bakery supply warehouse on Monday, the investigator said.
An initial inquiry raised suspicions that two Taiwan firms imported the powder from Australia and sold it to local bakeries as an ingredient for baked goods.

"The powder is cheap and fragrant like milk powder," the investigator said. "We believe some bakeries have been using the powder for cakes and bread in the past two years. We are looking for more evidence before we can charge them."
It was not known whether food made from the feed could be harmful to humans.
